evidence.source: Yang Huaiyuan and Sun Yingqiong, Fudan University Center for the Study of Excavated Texts and Paleography
evidence.text: The authors state that departure is not securely identifiable in the oracle-bone examples they discuss. They cite departure uses in received Zhouyi and Shijing passages—including 《詩經·大雅·生民》“鳥乃去矣” and 《小雅·斯干》“鳥鼠攸去”—and characterize these as Western Zhou usage; these quotations are from transmitted works, not independently dated manuscripts of the cited lines. They warn that 《尚書·胤征》 belongs to the later forged Old Text Shangshu and should not be used as early evidence.
evidence.title: 釋甲骨文中的“去”——兼論上古“去”聲字的韻尾

evidence.source: Yang Huaiyuan and Sun Yingqiong, Fudan University Center for the Study of Excavated Texts and Paleography
evidence.field: sections 1, 3–4; graph analysis and semantic development
evidence.text: The authors report the proposal that oracle 去 represented a large/open mouth and was an early graph for 呿, alongside a vessel-cover analysis associated with 盍. They reject the former and argue that oracle 去 is the early graph of 盍, citing a bronze 盍 form in 殷周金文集成 02794 analyzed as 去 plus 皿. They propose that the departure word differentiated from 盍 through a reversal from covering to uncovering/leaving, while acknowledging that departure is not secure in the oracle-bone examples discussed. This is the authors’ interpretation, not a directly documented semantic sequence.
evidence.title: 釋甲骨文中的“去”——兼論上古“去”聲字的韻尾
